findings.message: ".watch-img" has CSS `transform: scale(3)` and a GSAP tween animates scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: scale(3)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: scale: 3. Example: tl.fromTo('.watch-img', { scale: 3 }, { scale: 3, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: opacity 0.3s` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#scanLine" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left with the transform equivalent (x), e.g. tl.fromTo("#scanLine", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite) without a finite composition `data-duration`. The timeline can report an unbounded duration and make render planning fail.
findings.fixHint: Add a finite composition `data-duration`, or replace `repeat: -1` with `repeat: Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalDuration / singleCycleDuration) - 1)`.
